units.source_text: 后来，我便常常去看望先生，每次去先生都在家。

en.t: After that, I often went to visit Sensei, and each time I went he was at home.

units.source_text: 随着见到先生次数的增多，我也就越来越频繁地去先生家了。

en.t: As the number of times I saw Sensei increased, I went to his house more and more often.

units.source_text: 可是，先生对我的态度，无论是最初的寒暄，还是深交以后，都没有太大变化。

en.t: However, Sensei's attitude toward me did not change much, whether at our first exchange of greetings or after we had become close.

units.source_text: 先生总是很沉静，有时沉静得过头而显得有些孤寂。

en.t: Sensei was always very quiet, and at times he was so quiet that he seemed rather lonely.

units.source_text: 一开始，我就发现先生有着让人难以接近的怪异之处。

en.t: From the beginning, I sensed something strange in Sensei that made him hard to approach.

units.source_text: 可是，越是这样，我就越想要接近先生。

en.t: Yet the more he was like that, the more I wanted to draw near to him.

units.source_text: 对先生抱有这种感觉的，或许只有我一个人吧。

en.t: Perhaps I was the only one who felt this way about Sensei.

units.source_text: 后来的事实证明了我独有的这种直觉，

en.t: Later facts proved this intuition that was mine alone,

units.source_text: 被人说幼稚也好，愚蠢也罢，

en.t: whether people called me naive or foolish,

units.source_text: 能预感到这一点，至少使我为自己的直觉感到自豪和高兴。

en.t: and being able to foresee it made me, at least, feel proud and glad of my own intuition.
A person capable of loving others,
a person who could not help loving others,

units.source_text: 然而当别人要投入自己怀抱时，

en.t: and yet, when someone tried to enter his embrace,

units.source_text: 又不能张开双臂去拥抱对方的人——便是先生。

en.t: a person unable to open his arms and hold that person close, that was Sensei.
